{{Quote|Everyone, listen up. The captain will have already transmitted his preliminary report on us, his new rescues, and will be awaiting orders. If my experience with the New Republic Navy is any guide, those orders will be to keep us aboard and continue with his patrol until his course takes him near a place where he can drop us off with minimal loss of time or use of resources.|Bhindi Drayson about the captain|<ref name="MK" />}}
This '''individual''' was the [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] [[Burst Fire-class Deep-Space Patrol Vessel|''Burst Fire''-class Deep-Space Patrol Vessel]] ''[[Concussor]]''.<ref name="MK" /> In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> the ''Concussor'' responded to an [[Distress beacon/Legends|emergency beacon]] while on patrol and rescued an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] carrying an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Noble/Legends|noble]] and her entourage, who claimed that [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] had attacked their [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]] and let them adrift on an escape pod. In reality, the group was [[Wraith Squadron]], a recently reformed [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit that planned to capture the ''Concussor''.<ref name="MK" />

The Wraiths were given quarters aboard the ship, which they used to plan their next move. [[Bhindi Drayson]], the group's leader, believed that the captain would have transmitted his preliminary report regarding the people he had rescued and would be awaiting orders. Based on the protocols of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[New Republic Defense Fleet|navy]], she theorized that the captain would be ordered to keep the group aboard and continue his patrol until he reached a location where he could disembark them with minimal loss of time and resources.<ref name="MK" />

After the Wraiths succeeded in capturing the ''Concussor'', the captain and his crew were dropped off on a habitable [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of a distant [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] with substantial provisions to live off.<ref name="MK" />
